## Divide two powered fractions {#division}

Simplify each fraction first. To divide, multiply by the reciprocal of the second fraction.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$\left(\dfrac{p^2}{q}\right)^2\div\left(\dfrac{p}{q^2}\right)^{-1}$

::: {.fragment}

[Apply each outside power.]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{p^4}{q^2}\div\dfrac{q^2}{p}$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Invert the divisor and multiply.]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{p^4}{q^2}\times\dfrac{p}{q^2}=\dfrac{p^5}{q^4}$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$\left(\dfrac{u}{v}\right)^2\div\left(\dfrac{u^2}{v}\right)^{-1}$

Try it on paper, then select **Next** to check.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{u^2}{v^2}\div\dfrac{v}{u^2}$

$=\dfrac{u^2}{v^2}\times\dfrac{u^2}{v}=\dfrac{u^4}{v^3}$

:::
